_comment: Demo-only mcpo config (baked into the fiduciary/mcpo-demo image via Dockerfile.mcpo-demo, see AWS-DEMO-HOSTING-GUIDE.md §7). Deliberately excludes 'monarch' -- the public demo runs on synthetic/CSV holdings (PORTFOLIO_PROVIDER=csv), never real Monarch credentials. Keeps 'tavily' so the news-discovery feature works against real news; TAVILY_API_KEY is supplied to the mcpo container at runtime via an SSM secret (see task def), not stored here. 'time' is a harmless helper.
